nominee.longerDescription: Happy WW! This week I have Ayra Starr ✨! She is also an apop (african pop) and RnB artist similar to Tyla. I first heard about her through Spotify when her song “Hot Body” was recommended to me and I really like it. Tbh still do. Then for a while I haven’t got any of her songs recommended to me but then   In August her new album Starrgirl released and she featured many of my fav RnB artists like kwn, Wizkid, Leon Thomas, Rema, Zayn.. you get it it 😄 So after liking her songs a lot and seeing the album cover (pic 3) I decided to look her up cause it was promising and oh boy I wasn’t disappointed. Now I like her songs even more 😂 Hype 6.5/10, looks + songs got her here. 👅

comments.name: Canvas
comments.text: The order was different but we came (🤠) to the same conclusion! She does in fact seem like someone you would enjoy, so I'm pretty surprised that she only gets a 6.5 hype score

comments.text: Yeah, tbh its more like an 8, I was just comparing it to my 9.5 last week and I was super geeked out there
